verdict.rationale: GitLab Duo Agent Platform is a built-in AI assistant to which users can "delegate routine tasks, from code refactoring and security scans to research, to specialized AI agents." Agentic Chat runs in the GitLab UI, IDEs and the Duo CLI, has project context, and can "propose and implement solutions" such as turning issues into merge requests. Sessions track the work, and human-in-the-loop approvals keep users in control. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably in practice.
